svg.title: Which cause matches the warming?
svg.desc: Small multiples of 3 panels (Sun, Volcanoes, Greenhouse gases) with a shared value axis, each from 1900 to 2020, showing Measured, Model. Notes: Sun: Does not match: solar activity has not risen since 1960; Volcanoes: Does not match: only short cooling; Greenhouse gases: Matches the measured warming. Highest: 1.3 (Greenhouse gases · Model in 2020). Lowest: −0.1 (Volcanoes · Model in 1900, Volcanoes · Model in 1910, Volcanoes · Model in 1920, Volcanoes · Model in 1930, Volcanoes · Model in 1940, Volcanoes · Model in 1950, Volcanoes · Model in 1960, Volcanoes · Model in 1970, Volcanoes · Model in 1980, Volcanoes · Model in 1990, Volcanoes · Model in 2000, Volcanoes · Model in 2010, Volcanoes · Model in 2020).
